scenes.setting: Same suite, same night: an excited Danitz scribbles the Admiral of Blood's crimes in Ancient Feysac and briefs Klein on Senor (a suspected evil spirit — Wraith — with a luck-granting mystical item, seven or eight ships, flagship Tree of Flesh and Blood, 42,000-pound bounty) and on Steel Maveti, the flagship's second mate who summons zombies and rears puppets. Danitz is put in charge of gathering information on Steel; Klein, at the rain-streaked window: 'Tonight, Gehrman joins the hunt.'

The Cathedral of Waves, Bayam, the morning after the storm: Alger, about to sail for a Wind-blessed ingredient, is summoned by the white-haired, bulging-muscled Diocese Bishop Chogo and ordered to investigate the rumor that Vice Admiral Iceberg has received Death's Key. Alger privately plans to go through the motions — 'May the Storm be with you!'

The square outside the cathedral, scattered leaves and puddles after the storm: Alger decides to tour the places where pirates roam to put on a show of working hard — and to pocket any bounty of a few hundred pounds he happens to meet
scenes.text_anchor: liquid cash flow that could be added to his savings
